Angelic Incursions, Volume 1 Throughout history, tales of incursion into our realm from angelic beings have been reported. Maintaining great skepticism, these events are extremely difficult to lend credence to.
《天使入侵》卷一 自古以来，便有天使般的存有闯入我们领域的传闻。本着极大的怀疑态度，这类事件极难令人信服。
res#60439/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Start

The nature of the beings themselves often range from winged creatures, to floating orbs and other odd menageries. One must be careful not to indulge every fantasy told by a child or madman, and yet some are worth looking at. My studies have become focused to discount the most fanciful; though admittedly there is some amount of fancy in any such tale.
这些存有本身形态各异，从有翼生物到悬浮光球，再到种种怪诞之物。人须谨慎，不可轻信孩子或疯子讲出的每一个幻想；然而其中确有值得一观者。我的研究致力于剔除最荒诞的部分，尽管必须承认，任何此类故事里都难免带有几分幻想。

Start

Most scholars would relegate all such stories to mere fantasy, but I have found common threads that bind these tales together. One such thread is a connection to statues. Nearly all reputable instances of encounters with these creatures are had after handling a statue of great age or import. An excerpt from 'Timauron's Travels' describes a series of statues that seem bound to angelic beings.
多数学者会把这类故事统统归为幻想，但我发现这些传说之间存在着共同的线索。其中之一便与雕像有关：几乎所有可信的遭遇记录，都发生在人们接触过某座古老或重要的雕像之后。《蒂莫伦游记》的一段节选，描述了一组似乎与天使般的存在相系的雕像。
res#60439/whatIHaveToSay[3]
Start

With his touch, Timauron is able to make them change shape and later he is visited by them. In 'Tales of Ophrandria' angels are turned to stone by the Dark Lord, doomed to watch mankind and unable to help. 'Aster's Revolt' tells how stone sculpted to resemble life helps entities peer through from other worlds. The tales themselves are less important than the common theme; a connection to statues.
蒂莫伦以手触及，便能让它们变换形态，此后它们便来访于他。《奥弗兰德里亚故事集》中，天使被黑暗领主化为石头，注定只能注视人类，却无力相助。《阿斯特的反叛》则讲述：雕成生命之形的石头，能让异界的存有借此窥望此世。这些故事本身并不重要，重要的是它们共同的主题，与雕像的联结。
res#60439/whatIHaveToSay[4]
Start

You might ask, how can I give credit to such tales as statues come to life, when statues are often carved for the very reason of eliciting thoughts of danger or power? The answer is because I have seen it for myself. Indeed, a statue spoke to me as I carved it with my own hands. "Seek Leunamar's Aid" it said to me. And, "Free the others".
你或许会问：雕像常因让人联想到危险或力量而被雕出，我凭什么相信「雕像复活」这类故事？答案是，因为我自己见过。是的，当我一刀一刀亲手雕刻之时，一座雕像对我开口了。它对我说：「去寻卢纳玛尔之助。」又说：「释放其余的。」
res#60439/whatIHaveToSay[5]
Start

So surprised was I, that I dropped the piece and it broke. What did this mean? I cannot say for sure, and I have not to this day found any such aid from Leunamar, notwithstanding the blessings of following the way of light. And the statue which I carved? It resembled an angelic being, as described in a commission from the Arenquist Artist's guild.
我惊愕至极，失手把雕像摔碎了。这意味着什么？我无法断言。直到今日，我仍未寻得卢纳玛尔所谓的「援助」，尽管我蒙受着追随光明之道的种种祝福。而我雕的那座雕像呢？它形似一位天使得存有，正是阿伦奎斯特艺术家公会委托书中所描述的样子。

My studies shall continue, and will no doubt be added to this account as they develop.
我的研究仍将继续，日后若有进展，自当补入此篇。
